crossRefs.note: a land in which you shall eat bread without scarcity, you shall not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron…
Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

translations.web: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,
translations.bsb: This is the offering you are to accept from them: gold, silver, and bronze;
translations.kjv: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
translations.asv: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them: gold, and silver, and brass,
